recreation_brief: 1. Create a 16:9 slide with light gray background (#f2f2f2). 2. Add a blue rectangle banner at top-left containing white bold text 'Training Samples with Labels (Two Classes)'. 3. Add a yellow circle with '20' at top-right. 4. On the left side, create two main columns: left column header 'Positive Class' in red, below it '"Shoot the Enemy"' in quotes, below it 'Label'; then a column of five airplane sketches; then a red vertical box with '+1' repeated five times. 5. Next to it, header 'Negative Class' in green, below it '"Safe"' in quotes, below it 'Label'; then a column of five airplane sketches; then a green vertical box with '0' repeated five times. 6. On the right side, stack three panels vertically: top panel 'Activation Function' with text 'Sigmoid function (0, +1)', 'Threshold at "0.5"', and a small sigmoid graph; middle panel 'Training' with flow diagram Input Sample -> Model ([Any value] -> [0, +1]) -> Predicted Class -> LOSS (orange circle), with Label of Input Sample (+1, 0) pointing to LOSS; bottom panel 'Evaluation' with flow Test Sample -> Model ([Any value] -> [0, +1]) -> Predicted Class (+1, 0). 7. Use dark red (#a00000) for Model boxes, orange (#f5a623) for LOSS circle, red (#d00000) for Positive Class header, green (#4caf50) for Negative Class header.
